name: car-deals-search-mcp
description: Search used car listings from Cars.com, Autotrader and KBB (US) or Autotrader UK, Motors.co.uk, Cinch and eBay Motors (UK), plus UK MOT history checks. MCP-compatible server (Python, stdio).
author: dan0v

tools.name: search_car_deals
tools.description: Search for car deals across US (Cars.com, Autotrader, KBB) and UK (Autotrader UK, Motors.co.uk, Cinch, eBay Motors) sources

tools.name: get_listing_details
tools.description: Fetch a single listing's detail page as markdown

tools.name: check_mot_history
tools.description: UK only. Check a UK vehicle's MOT history via GOV.UK and surface outstanding defects, advisories, MOT expiry, and safety recalls
